The communication control commands can be executed at any time. Flow of command process using EtherNet/IP (example of connection with PLC EtherNet/IP unit)

The controller performs command control via EtherNet/IP in the following manner.

· In the case of a command for which there is no response data, data is not output in response to the Command Data.

Checks the completion of command execution and refers to the reply data and command execution results

by detecting that the Command complete flag is ON. Detects the rising of the Command request

flag, executes the command from the Command Number, reads the command parameter from the address

corresponding to CommandParameter, and turns the Command ready flag OFF.

The communication control commands can be executed at any time. Flow of command process using EtherNet/IP (example of connection with PLC EtherNet/IP unit)

The controller performs command control via EtherNet/IP in the following manner.

· In the case of a command for which there is no response data, data is not output in response to the Command Data.

Checks the completion of command execution and refers to the reply data and command execution results

by detecting that the Command complete flag is ON. Detects the rising of the Command request

flag, executes the command from the Command Number, reads the command parameter from the address

corresponding to CommandParameter, and turns the Command ready flag OFF.
